use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

claims.content: The C2 JU's objective is to define reference points and geometric areas, such as an Area of Probability (AOP) with a 95% probability (2 sigma) of containing a particular emitter, while ensuring that emergency alerts are not used on reference points, lines, or areas.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The C2 JU defines reference points and geometric areas (e.g., an Area of Probability for emitter location).
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: In one successful instance, the C2 JU defines a geometric Area of Probability (AOP) for a particular emitter, i.e., an area with a 95% probability (2 sigma) of containing that emitter, and the resulting reference points/lines/areas are not used with emergency alerts.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The C2 JU has a need to create a reference point or geometric area (e.g., an AOP for a particular emitter).
scope_contract.success_boundary: The reference point or geometric area is defined (e.g., an AOP with a 95% probability/2-sigma location area) and is not associated with emergency alerts.
excluded_adjacent_actions: Extrapolating target positions to the time of transmission for Surveillance NPG reporting
Correlating/validating local sensor data against interface reports
Applying emergency alerts to reference points, lines, or areas
variant_dimensions: Reference points vs. lines vs. areas

covered_aspect_ids: C² JU must extrapolate target position to transmission time

claims.content: C2 JU
Emergency alerts are not used on reference points, lines, or areas.

The C2 JU is capable of generating and maintaining track numbers to report an Area of Probability (AOP). To define/report an AOP, the system requires valid data sources: organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination thereof. To define a slaved point or area, a Related TN must be available so that the position can be established as Delta Latitude and 1/Delta Longitude from that Related TN when the Slaved Indicator is set to value 1.

The use case is triggered when the C2 JU needs to report tactical information about geographic references (such as waypoints, CAP stations, FEBA) or fixed ground units/objects (such as troop concentrations, bridges, airbases); when a Slaved Indicator is set to value 1 in a report for slaved points/areas; or when a C2 JU (or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers) reports an Area of Probability (AOP) based on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.

claims.content: The C2 JU identifies the particular emitter for which an Area of Probability (AOP) is to be defined.
The C2 JU defines the AOP as the geometric area within which there is a 95% probability (2 sigma) of containing that emitter.
The C2 JU assigns a TN(s) to the AOP and reports its position using geodetic latitude/longitude values.
The C2 JU reports the time associated with the AOP in hours/minutes, with its meaning defined by the Time Function field.

The C2 JU reports the AOP using a J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum, transmitting the J3.7I word with the FIX BRG field set to value 1, and reports a Target Position Quality (TPQ) value corresponding to the calculated AOP probability area (S) according to Table 4.4-7 / the S-to-TPQ relationship; if Variable Track Quality (VTQ) is activated, any calculated TQ exceeding the manually entered maximum value is reported as that entered value.
The C2 JU ensures that emergency alerts are not used on the AOP or on any reference point, line, or area.

Diverges from Step 2: Instead of defining an AOP, the C2 JU defines and reports a reference point, line, area, or volume using a J3.0 message; such a message can carry lines (e.g., FEBAs or roads), areas (e.g., search or exercise areas), and volumes (e.g., corridors).
Diverges from Step 2: Instead of defining an AOP, the C2 JU reports a circle/ellipse about a ground point (e.g., a SAM site) using a J3.5 message.

Diverges from Step 2: If a segmented line is formed by joining 2 or 3 points, the C2 JU reports it in a single J3.0 message with the Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to No Statement, the End Point field set to 1, and the Point/Line/Area Descriptor,1 field set to 2 (Line).

Diverges from Step 2: If a segmented line or multisided area is formed by joining more than 3 points, the C2 JU reports it using multiple J3.0 messages, each with a unique TN; the second and subsequent messages have the Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to 1; the point location in the extension word of each subsequent message must match the last point location of the previous message; and for a multisided area, the last point location transmitted must be the same as the initial point location to close the figure.
Diverges from Step 3: If a fix is changed to an AOP, the C2 JU uses the TN of the previously reported fix for the new AOP.
Diverges from Step 3: If an AOP is formed from a single fix, the C2 JU retains the same TN; if it is formed from 2 or more fixes, the C2 JU assigns a new TN.
Diverges from Step 3: If the entity is reported as Data Report Type 4 (Datum), the same TN may be used by operator action.

claims.content: Exception — illegal R² assumption for another unit's EW product: At step 5, if the C2 JU attempts to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report, that assumption is illegal and is not performed. Exit: the attempted R² assumption is prevented.

Exception — change to a segmented line or multisided area: At step 2, while defining a segmented line or multisided area (the non-AOP geometric-area case), if the C2 JU changes data for any point comprising a portion of the line/area, the entire line/area must be transmitted by the reporting JU, and receiving units must purge the previously held segmented line or multisided area and replace it with the new report. Exit: the full line/area is transmitted and receiving units hold the replacement report.

Exception — emergency alert prohibited on reference geometry: At step 6, if an emergency alert is attempted on a reference point, line, or area (including the AOP being defined), the emergency alert is not used on that entity; emergency alerts are not used on reference points, lines, or areas. Exit: the emergency alert is not applied.

claims.content: The C2 JU has reported the defined reference point or geometric area (e.g., AOP, line, area) with all required parameters (such as Track Number, position, and time), and no emergency alert is associated with it.

For a defined Area of Probability (AOP), the system state includes a Track Number assigned to the AOP for all subsequent updates, and the AOP is the geometric area with a 95% probability (2 sigma) of containing the particular emitter.

For a defined AOP, the C2 JU has reported a Target Position Quality (TPQ) value corresponding to the calculated probability area (S) according to Table 4.4-7 / the S-to-TPQ relationship table; if Variable Track Quality (VTQ) is activated, any calculated TQ exceeding the manually entered maximum value is reported as that entered maximum.

The defined reference point, line, or area remains active on the interface unless explicitly purged, and the originator retains reporting responsibility (R²) as long as it remains active and reports the entity.
For a slaved point or area, the position is established as Delta Latitude and 1/Delta Longitude from the Related TN at the time of the report, with the Slaved Indicator set to value 1.

quality_flags.detail: [mainflow_trigger_continuity] The Trigger lists multiple distinct initiations: reporting geographic references/fixed ground objects, reporting slaved points/areas with Slaved Indicator=1, and reporting an AOP. The Main Flow jumps directly to step 1 'identifies the particular emitter for which an Area of Probability (AOP) is to be defined' and the remaining steps only cover AOP reporting. No branch or step handles the reference-point/geometric-area trigger cases or the slaved-point/area case, so the flow does not continue from those Trigger branches and cannot reach the slaved-point postcondition. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (The 'non-AOP' qualifier is not supported by the cited evidence; the cited evidence only supports the J3.5 message capability for reporting points, not for lines or areas.))

[mainflow_trigger_continuity] The trigger opens the use case for multiple scenarios: reporting geographic references such as waypoints/CAP/FEBA, fixed ground units/objects, slaved points/areas, and AOP reporting. Main Flow step 1 immediately jumps to identifying an emitter for an AOP and never returns to the non-AOP trigger branches. For any non-AOP triggering event, the main flow restarts as a different scenario and does not continue from the trigger. This also makes the corresponding non-AOP and slaved postconditions unreachable. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (The Slaved Indicator=1 condition is supported as a trigger/precondition, not as an explicit C2 JU action; the rewritten wording uses the supported conditional state.))

[mainflow_trigger_continuity] The Trigger commits to multiple paths: non-AOP geographic references/fixed objects, slaved points/areas with Slaved Indicator=1, and AOP reporting. The Main Flow executes only the AOP path (identify emitter, define 95% area, assign TN/report time/TPQ). It never continues from the reference-point/slaved-point triggers; consequently, the postcondition for slaved point/area position from a Related TN is also unreachable.

inconsistency_hints: The Trigger allows an AOP to be reported 'based on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above,' but the Preconditions only state TN generation capability and the emergency-alerts constraint. There is no precondition establishing that the relevant source data are available/configured before the AOP report can be initiated.

The Trigger includes slaved points/areas (Slaved Indicator=1), and the Postconditions require the position to be established as Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude from the Related TN. A related track number must already exist before a slaved point/area can be defined, but the Preconditions do not include this requirement.

Postcondition 3 requires the C2 JU to report a Target Position Quality (TPQ) value corresponding to the calculated AOP probability area (S) per Table 4.4-7 / the S-to-TPQ relationship, including the VTQ maximum override if activated. The main flow's AOP reporting step only specifies the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence with FIX BRG=1; it does not instruct the actor to compute or report TPQ, so this postcondition is not reached by the stated flow.
